Theorem
[Asymptotic Ricci lower bounds and volume growth] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0035, cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0036, cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0037 1. Theorem 4.9\group section-4

Let $M^n$ be a complete noncompact Riemannian manifold, and let $\gamma :[0,\infty ) o M^n$ be a ray from some $p\in M^n$.

  1. Fix $0\le u \le frac 12(n+1)/(n-1)$. If $ u \ge frac 12$, assume that for some $r_0>0$ and all $r>r_0$ we have

    egin{equation} ag {4.37} \Ric _M(x)\ge (n-1) rac{( rac14- u ^2)}{r^2}. \end{equation}

    If $0 \leq u < rac12$, assume that for some $r_1$ such that $r_0 < r_1 < rac32 r_0$ and for all $r > r_0$,

    egin{equation} ag {4.38} \RicM (x) \geq (n-1) rac{\left( rac14- u ^2 ight)}{ igl(r-2(r_1-r_0) igr)^2}. \end{equation}

    If $0 \leq u < rac12 (n+1)/(n-1)$, then there exists $C_{r_1}$, independent of $M^n$ such that for $r > 2r_1-r_0$

    egin{equation} ag {4.39} c_{r_1}V_{(r_1-r_0)}(\gamma (r_1))\, r^{(n-1)( rac12- u )+1} \leq V_{r+(r_1-r_0)}(p). \end{equation}

  2. If $ u = rac12 (n+1)/(n-1)$, and (4.37) holds, then for $r > 2r_1-r_0$

    egin{equation} ag {4.40} c_{r_1}V_{(r_1-r_0)}(\gamma (r_1))\log r \leq V_{r+(r_1-r_0)}(p). \end{equation}

  3. For all $ u \geq 0$, if (4.37) holds (in radial directions), then

    egin{equation} ag {4.41} V_r(p) < c_M r^{(n-1)( rac12+ u )+1}. \end{equation}

Proof

Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0036, cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0037 ↗ prop:relative-volume-estimates \sketch Apply Proposition 5 to the model Jacobi field determined by $dr^2+J_{ u ,R}^2(r)g$. For $ u \geq 1/2$, the curvature hypothesis gives the required radial comparison directly, and the asymptotics of $J_{ u ,R}$ give the power lower bound (4.39). For $0\leq u <1/2$, the shifted denominator in (4.38) gives the same comparison after moving the model origin by $2(r_1-r_0)$. The endpoint value $ u = rac12(n+1)/(n-1)$ is the critical exponent, hence the integral gives the logarithmic lower bound (4.40). The upper bound (4.41) is the corresponding Heintze–Karcher radial comparison \cite{cgt-heintze-karcher}.
